reason: The first reading gave only letter groups; with the psalm text to hand the line beginnings of one face could be read as connected words and placed.

Source-assisted reading of F-lodh (Leipzig UB, Fragm. lat. 367a), 13 October 2026. Reread on the image by a research reader, with the Gallican psalter text to hand: canvas 1 (367a-1: 1v) lines 2-6, 8-9, 11-15. Lines attempted on canvases 0, 2 and 3 are word shapes only. Not reviewed by a human palaeographer. ( ) = resolved abbreviation, [ ] = lost or unread, ? = doubtful.
